description.zh: 出口、GDP、科學園區、各縣市工廠與歷年市值前十名，用官方統計畫出台灣的產業結構，加上六個公共爭論的各方說法。
description.en: Exports, GDP, science parks, factories by county and twenty years of market-cap rankings: Taiwan’s industrial structure in official statistics, plus six public debates in each side’s own words.

description.en: Three supply chains — semiconductors, AI servers and tungsten — broken into links: which Taiwanese companies work in each and which link is supplied from abroad, with a source on every node.

description.zh: 從 1953 年的經建計畫到 2026 年的臺美貿易協定，37 個事件分成政策、企業、資本市場、國際四條線，每筆附官方出處。
description.en: From the economic plans of 1953 to the 2026 Taiwan–US trade agreement: 37 events on four tracks — policy, companies, capital market, international — each with an official source.
